synth.notes:
Ring moves y+-6 on A1/A2 carrying on-beam blocks; beam w+-6 on A4/A3; clicks are no-ops.
Step-87 fix: hook = ANY block on beam rows at x == tip-4 (tag-agnostic), then every block fully on the beam follows the tip; unhooked extend pushes the swept strip.
Block A4 [arm] no_change vs x is geometry, not a counter: a chain that would leave the colour-4 field leaves the beam sliding alone; vertical blocked -> whole move cancels.
Tags: hooked next alone on beam -> collected; collected off beam reverts; legend centre 2x2 = 0 while collected.
HUD row: 3s = (n-1)//3, n = non-click actions, kept in a memo keyed by returned frames (fallback 3*bars+1 or 0); hypothesised global-counter guard refuted.
